notes.title: 1.0.3 bugfix
notes.notes: Fixed some minor issues that were reported in the bug report, such as text errors. Thanks for all your reports!

notes.title: Dream Diary: Trish slightly changed
notes.notes:
A lot of players found this diary page too frustrating, so I decided to make a small change:
- +1 max HP
-weapon accuracy set to 100

Further changes would require more time and testing, so they are not implementable at the moment

notes.title: 1.0.2 bugfix
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you all for the overwhelming reception of the game. I really don't know how to thank you enough. Huge thanks to everyone playing and leaving a review!

This small patch brings a few adjustments:
-now you can take screenshots with F12
-fixed a bug that didn't correctly apply the First Blood damage in a specific scenario
-fixed a bug that caused save data not to be deleted properly
-fixed minor issues
-added an option to romance the long-gilled fish (maybe this isn't true)

notes.title: 1.0.1 bugfix
notes.notes:
-fixed a bug that allowed staying alive with 0 HP
-fixed text errors
-fixed a bug that allowed reaching a negative fragment count
-the enemy with the countdown received two small changes: it will now tell you when it's the last turn, and the number 0 will be displayed instead of disappearing when you run out of turns

notes.title: NO-SKIN is out now!
notes.notes:
NO-SKIN 1.0 is finally available.

Thank you for all the support I received during the game's development. It was truly unexpected, and I can never thank you enough for the kind words.

The game is 15% off at launch.

A huge thanks to everyone who leaves a review, it really means a lot!

notes.title: NO-SKIN launches on February 17th!
notes.notes:
The release date for NO-SKIN is set for February 17, 2025! I've released a new trailer announcing the launch date:

[previewyoutube=BRIt1a9sjV0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks to everyone who played the demo, wishlisted the game, and is looking forward to the final version.

NOTE: The demo will soon no longer be available for download on Steam, as save data will not be compatible with the final game, and it's more of an old version than a proper demo. If you still want to play it, you can download it for free on Itch.io: https://noeye-soft.itch.io/no-skin (save data is compatible with what you were playing on Steam)

notes.title: Beta test available(ver 0.6)
notes.notes:
A beta test version of the game (0.6) is now available! You can access it through the library page by right-clicking on NO-SKIN Demo > Properties > Betas > 0.6_betatest

Here’s a list of the main new features:

-New area: A new area has been added, which includes new enemies, bosses, items, upgrades, etc.

-New permanent upgrades: New upgrades can now be purchased from the moon, and some old upgrades have been updated.

-Dream Diary: The first two pages of the dream diary have been updated. NOTE: Only the first two recollections, Mary and Rugs, have been updated. The others remain unchanged. This is a kind of teaser for how the other recollections will be developed in the final release.

-QoL improvements: Now you can save your run, along with the ability to disable permanent upgrades,
and more.

Save files from version 0.5 will not be compatible with 0.6. The way permanent upgrades work has changed, and overall, the progression is different.

This version is much more experimental than 0.5, so feel free to report bugs or leave your feedback.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated to version 0.5! This update primarily focuses on:

-QoL/Accessibility: Based on your feedback, accessibility has been improved (like the ability to rebind keyboard keys), and several mechanics have been enhanced (such as inventory management)

-Texts: A number of incorrect texts have been fixed, and new ones have been added or existing ones modified for better consistency

-Balancing: The game's balance has undergone significant changes. Many players complained that the difficulty was too low, and since it's already possible to lower the difficulty, I've decided to better balance the strategies that allowed for easy wins. In general, overpowered mechanics/items have been nerfed, and elements that were clearly weaker than other available options have been buffed. Feel free to share your thoughts on this balance—I believe there's still plenty of room for improvement!

-And more???
